summary.text: Tom Umberg represents District 34 in the California State Senate and chairs the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate he served three terms in the State Assembly, was Deputy Drug Czar under President Bill Clinton, and was a federal prosecutor; he is a retired U.S. Army Colonel.
He holds degrees from UCLA, the UC College of the Law San Francisco and the U.S. Army War College.
